build_actor_model: build a FullyConnected actor model with custom layer sizes and activations for discrete action spaces
create_fully_connected_net_builder: create a FullyConnected net builder with configurable hidden layer sizes and activation functions
configure_normalization: configure batch norm or layer norm on the FullyConnected actor network builder
set_exploration_variance: set the exploration variance parameter on the FullyConnected actor for stochastic action selection
validate_sizes_activations: validate that the sizes and activations lists have matching lengths in the FullyConnected builder
